detected.detail: reflection gate: NFR-F1-validation-messages ('Validation errors name the offending field rather than a generic bad request. Owned at the API boundary.') has no covering test. T5 checks that the service raises a validation error before any DB write (a service-layer concern), but no test asserts that the API boundary HTTP response body names the offending field. A behavior or fitness test must POST an invalid payload (e.g. negative quantity, missing required field) to the real-branch endpoint and assert the response contains a field-named error message.
detected.resolution: revised by human-proxy: full design re-run (test_list gate)
